d: The Timberwolves defeated the Clippers, 127-101 tonight in Minnesota. LaMelo Ball contributed a team-high 24 points to go with 7 assists 6 three pointers and 4 rebounds, with Jaden McDaniels of the Timberwolves adding an additional 23 points (11-15 FG, 1-2 3P) in the game. Darius Garland finished with a team-high 24 points along with 5 assists for the Clippers in the losing effort. The Timberwolves improve their record to 4-2 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 1-4 for the season.
